_comment: Textures removed so modern Minecraft renders its own (correct) version. Cases, all verified against vanilla old-vs-new: (1) The horse was reworked in 1.11 - the 1.8.9 texture fills only ~28% of the UV the modern model reads -> mostly invisible horse, and (unlike the chest) the re-unwrap has no clean remap. (2) The creative-inventory tabs, whose art in the proving-ground pack is unfinished dev placeholders (red 'UN SEL' / blue 'SEL' boxes, ~94% transparent panels) - vanilla is the better outcome. (3) villager.png, the one GUI whose modern REFERENCE CANVAS differs from 1.8.9's: 1.8.9 is 240x166 content on a 256x256 canvas, modern is 276x166 on a 512x256 canvas. The filename is identical in both eras and no slice record reads it (they read villager2.png), so it passes straight through and modern samples it at scale (1.0, 2.0) -> vertically squashed, slots misplaced, GUI overflowing. 1.14's trading redesign also added a trade-list panel on the left that has NO 1.8.9 counterpart, so there is nothing to remap it from. See docs/known-issues.md #5. (4) NOTE: entries here are unconditional VERSION FACTS, true of every 1.8.9 pack. Judgements about a particular pack's art belong in conformance.json, which measures them per pack — the enchanting table and the four creative tabs moved there 2026-08-02.
